Fwd: routing & procurement constraint notes (internal)

Folks — copying below the procurement gating rules I've been tracking (pulled from recent deals):

- When an external partner is the named procurement vendor on the RFP, Redwood will accept their role as primary but requires a Redwood-controlled SOW appendix to preserve runtime SLA terms.
- For accounts with vendor consolidation preferences (Acme AI, Meridian Health) we require a single point of contact in the partner organization and an agreed-upon data contract before we cede primary ownership.
- Suggested MR rule (temporary): "Procurement-opened ticket within 48 hours + named vendor = partner primary". This guards against opportunistic late procurement tickets.

I've updated the attached matrix with color-coded MR flags. Also, the BridgeWorks SOW has a delivery SLA that conflicts with our standard 99.9% runtime warranty; recommend redline to clause 3.2 and pass to legal.

Karthik
